tools.name: search_systems
tools.summary: Find chemical systems in ORCHID. elements: e.g. ["Al","Ni"] (systems containing all of them; exact=true for exactly them). text: matches system names and titles/citations of reporting papers.

tools.name: get_invariant_reactions
tools.summary: Invariant reactions of a system: literature records (source="literature"), invariants calculated from each SGTE assessment (source="calculated"), or both side by side with phase-set matches and dT.

tools.name: get_formation_enthalpy
tools.summary: Formation enthalpy of a compound (e.g. "Al3Ni"): literature values in kJ/mol-atom with provenance, Materials Project and OQMD DFT entries at that composition, and per-evidence-class / per-source summaries. fields: "summary" (default; id, property, value, unit, T, phases, evidence class, accepted, espei_ready, espei_certified, calphad_check, citation, DOI, page, quote <= 240 chars or table locator) or "full" (complete provenance).

tools.name: get_phase_diagram
tools.summary: Calculated binary phase diagram(s): TDB file, SHA-256, assessment citation/DOI, phases, invariants, viewer URL. assessment: TDB name (e.g. "AlNi-05Mie") or DOI; omit for all.

tools.name: list_tdb_files
tools.summary: TDB catalog entries for systems containing all `elements` (exact=true: exactly them). tier: bundled | fetched | manual.

tools.name: get_tdb
tools.summary: One TDB catalog entry (e.g. "AlNi-05Mie.tdb") with licence, SHA-256 and download URL.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.summary: Bibliographic record of a paper by DOI (or ORCHID id: "doi:...", "nodoi:...", literature "ref:..." ids, or a bibliography key "p..."): systems, number of values it reports, its experimental-context items (quotes, pages), and its ORCHID bibliography entry: roles (corpus_assessment_read, cited_original_source, tdb_source_assessment, handbook_diagram_source, discovery_lead, ...), evidence summary (values by evidence class / property group, tables, passages, ESPEI datasets, phase-registry phases), Crossref metadata, open-access licence from Crossref, relation counts. fields="full" adds the complete bibliography record and every relation (edges with provenance).

tools.name: search_papers
tools.summary: Search the ORCHID bibliography (every paper ORCHID knows about). system: exact chemical system ("Al-Ni"); elements: papers with a system containing all of them. role: corpus_assessment_read | cited_original_source | tdb_source_assessment | tdb_compilation | handbook_diagram_source | discovery_lead | context_source | espei_reference. property: property code of values reported in / citing the paper (HM_FORM, INVARIANT_TEMPERATURE, ...). evidence_class: experimental | model | dft | unspecified. year_from / year_to; text: substring of title, authors or DOI.

tools.name: get_paper_relations
tools.summary: Typed relations of one paper (DOI or bibliography id), each with provenance. relation: cites (paper -> works printed as the source of its values; count = values) | used_in_assessment (data paper -> assessments that used it) | models_system_in_tdb (paper -> TDB file) | reassesses (later -> earlier assessment of the same exact system that it cites) | handbook_reproduces (handbook diagram -> original evaluation) | cited_by_crossref (publisher-deposited Crossref reference lists). direction: out | in | both.

tools.name: get_assessment_evidence
tools.summary: Assessments of an exact chemical system (papers behind its TDB files or read by ORCHID) with the original data papers each used (works printed as the source of the extracted values, with value counts and evidence classes), the TDB files, reassessment links (citation+same-system) and paper counts by role. max_data_papers caps the data-paper list per assessment (flag data_papers_truncated).

tools.name: compare_to_dft
tools.summary: Literature formation enthalpies vs Materials Project vs OQMD for the compounds of a system, with residuals (DFT - literature), MAE over the default experimental subset, and the DFT hull vertices of both sources. fields: "summary" (default; per literature value: id, value, evidence class, accepted, phase, T, citation, DOI, page, quote <= 240 chars, table, residuals) or "full" (method, cited sources, flags, DFT point details).

tools.name: get_phase
tools.summary: One phase of a binary system from the ORCHID phase registry. system: e.g. "Al-Ni". phase: a registry id ("phase:al-ni:fcc-l12"), any namespaced name ("tdb:AlNi-01Dup-LB.tdb:L12_FCC", "paper:<doi>:<label>", "corpus:<id>", "mp:<id>", "oqmd:<id>") or a plain label ("L12_FCC", "NI3TI", "gamma'"); several matches return {ambiguous: true, matches}.

tools.name: search_phases
tools.summary: Search the ORCHID phase registry (binary systems). elements: phases of systems containing all of them. name: substring of the phase name, TDB names, paper or corpus labels. prototype: prototype, Strukturbericht, Pearson symbol or structure-type id ("AuCu3", "L1_2" = "L12", "cP4"). tier: A | B | C | liquid | gas | none. status: assigned | needs_review | unresolved_no_candidates.

tools.name: get_structure_type
tools.summary: Crystal-structure types of the phase registry by id, prototype, Strukturbericht, Pearson symbol or space group ("AuCu3", "L1_2", "cP4", "Pm-3m", "221"): prototype, Strukturbericht, Pearson, space group, sources (Hallstedt 2025 crystallographic table, standard tables), number of registry phases and example phase ids.
